QuestInfo.name: An Unfamiliar Town
QuestInfo.0: Travelling through the portal, you arrive in an unfamiliar town.
QuestInfo.1: Talk to #bChief Stan#k, who seemingly has lived in this town for a long time.
QuestInfo.2: You arrived in an unfamiliar town after using the Interdimensional Portal. When you talked to the chief of the town, he told you that this place is a town in a place called #bVictoria Island#k. He also told you that there is someone from Ossyria, where you used to live, at the Bowman Instructional School.
